plan.title: Direct eRFX RFQ Split Award to POs

steps.note: Open the direct eRFX create screen.
Enable direct eRFX project creation.
Enable split awards.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event title required for publishing and later list lookup.
Replace the default Auction with an RFQ-only project.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the requested CYLINDER line with quantity 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet.
Set the requested delivery location on the line item.
Invite two QA vendors for the competing bids.
Commit the immediate 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the complete RFQ event.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor's quote at 100.
Verify the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's quote at 90.
Verify the second vendor bid was accepted.
Wait for the bidding window to close before awarding.
Open the comparison grid containing both bids.
Enter the awarding flow.
Allocate 6 units to the second bidder, corresponding to the 90 quote.
Allocate the remaining 4 units to the first bidder, corresponding to the 100 quote.
Verify both vendors are selected and the split total is 6×90 plus 4×100 = 940.
Create the split-award proposal.
Submit the proposal for approval.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award as the pending buyer approver.
Complete approval and create the purchase orders.
Verify two PO lines were created, corresponding to the two awarded vendors.
Return to the events list to verify history placement.
Open the History tab.
Verify the awarded event appears in History.
Reopen the completed event from the history list.
Verify Recreate Order remains available for this direct event.
